findings.title: Missing RemoveMutationObserver in Cycle Collection Unlink
findings.message: The change to make mStylesheetDocument a strong reference (RefPtr) added it to the NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_WRAPPERCACHE macro, which handles both traverse and unlink operations automatically. However, when the cycle collector unlinks mStylesheetDocument (sets it to null), it does not call RemoveMutationObserver(this) first. The txMozillaXSLTProcessor registers itself as a mutation observer on mStylesheetDocument via AddMutationObserver(this) in ImportStylesheet(). When the document is unlinked during cycle collection, the document still holds a dangling pointer to the txMozillaXSLTProcessor as a mutation observer. When the document is later destroyed and tries to notify observers, it accesses freed memory, causing a use-after-free crash in nsINode::LastRelease().
findings.suggestion: When using NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_WRAPPERCACHE with mStylesheetDocument, a separate UNLINK handler must be implemented that calls mStylesheetDocument->RemoveMutationObserver(this) before the reference is cleared. The correct approach is to use NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_WRAPPERCACHE_CLASS with separate UNLINK_BEGIN/END and TRAVERSE_BEGIN/END macros, where UNLINK calls Reset() or explicitly removes the mutation observer before unlinking the document reference.
findings.suggestion_code:
NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_WRAPPERCACHE_CLASS(txMozillaXSLTProcessor)

NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_UNLINK_BEGIN(txMozillaXSLTProcessor)
  NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_UNLINK(mOwner, mSource)
  MOZ_RELEASE_ASSERT(tmp->mState == State::None);
  tmp->Reset(IgnoreErrors());  // This calls RemoveMutationObserver
  NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_UNLINK_PRESERVED_WRAPPER
NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_UNLINK_END

NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_TRAVERSE_BEGIN(txMozillaXSLTProcessor)
  NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_TRAVERSE(
      mOwner, mStylesheetDocument, mEmbeddedStylesheetRoot, mSource, mVariables)
NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_TRAVERSE_END

ground_truth.root_cause: The NS_IMPL_CYCLE_COLLECTION_WRAPPERCACHE macro automatically handles both traversal and unlinking of member references. However, when unlinking mStylesheetDocument, custom cleanup code (RemoveMutationObserver) must be called first. The change to make mStylesheetDocument strong used the convenient macro without implementing a custom UNLINK handler that properly deregisters the mutation observer before the document reference is cleared.

must_cover.reason: Contains the vulnerable cycle collection macro that automatically unlinks mStylesheetDocument without calling RemoveMutationObserver first. This creates a dangling pointer in the document's observer list, leading to use-after-free when the document is destroyed and tries to notify observers.

must_cover.reason: Registers the txMozillaXSLTProcessor as a mutation observer on mStylesheetDocument via AddMutationObserver(this). This establishes the observer relationship that must be properly cleaned up before unlinking, but the cycle collection macro does not do this cleanup.

Demonstrates the correct cleanup pattern: checks if mStylesheetDocument exists and calls RemoveMutationObserver(this) before the document reference is cleared. This is the cleanup that the cycle collection UNLINK handler should have performed but doesn't.

Called when the stylesheet document is being destroyed. Shows the mutation observer callback path that will access freed memory if the txMozillaXSLTProcessor has been cycle-collected without proper observer deregistration.
